Massa omogenea, non captante, ipointensa:
A homogeneous, non-enhancing mass, hypointense on T1 and hyperintense on FLAIR, expanding the insula and operculum in a young adult: the typical picture of diffuse low-grade glioma, often IDH-mutant. The insula is a common site. It is not an infarct: there is mass effect and the shape does not follow an arterial territory (try the territories atlas after answering). Glioblastoma usually shows ring enhancement and necrosis; lymphoma enhances homogeneously and lies periventricularly.
In the report: site and volume, relation to the internal capsule, basal ganglia and lenticulostriate vessels, mass effect.
